title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-enhancements
author: Aisha Kaur
description:
Motivation: production incidents (see ENG-1723) exposed gaps in observability and safety for automated rollback decisions during canary/AB/shadow rollouts. This PR improves telemetry, introduces stability guards, and tightens metric-driven auto-rollback logic so we reduce noisy rollbacks and make root-cause triage faster.

What this changes (high level):
- Emit deterministic rollback decision events to the rollout-event stream (reason, triggering-metrics, window, sample traces).
- Add quorum and debounce logic for quarantine metrics used by the autorollback engine (avoids flapping on small sample sizes).
- Surface canary/AB/shadow-specific telemetry in rollout dashboards: per-stage latency/error histograms, request sampling ids, and KV cache hit rate.
- Introduce a safety gate that prevents automated rollback for transient upstream 503 spikes when downstream SLOs are healthy.
- Expose lightweight feature-flag toggles for progressive rollout policies so infra teams can opt-in before enabling globally.
- New e2e stability tests and CI gating for rollout decision path.

Why this approach: we observed two classes of failures: (1) noisy metrics with low request counts causing premature autorollback; (2) lack of clear signals at time of rollback making post-mortem slow. Combining quorum/debounce with richer rollback events addresses both.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add rollback-event emitter and schema (backwards-compatible).
- [x] Add quorum logic + parameterized debounce windows.
- [x] Add dashboard panels and _backend_ telemetry tags.
- [x] Add feature-flags and default off for private clusters.
- [x] Unit + integration + e2e tests for key paths.
- [x] Update docs and playbook snippets (rollout runbook)

Testing and CI:
- Unit tests for quorum/debounce logic.
- Integration tests against mock metrics backend (metric noise scenarios).
- New e2e test that simulates staged shadow+canary with metric quorum and verifies autorollback only on sustained regressions.
- CI: all checks green on branch; flaky test run (stability) executed twice locally.

Migration notes: rollout-event schema is additive; downstream consumers should handle older events. Feature flags default to off for Private installs; Hosted clusters will be opt-in via console until gradual rollout completes.

Related: builds on prior rollout work (see PRs 214001, 216000, 23184) and ties to ENG-1723/ENG-2048 for incident follow-ups.

Operational playbook snippet (short): when an autorollback occurs, the emitted event includes reason, metric window, quorum size, sample trace ids. Use the new rollback-events dashboard to determine whether to re-run canary with increased sample size or quarantine metric before manual rollback.

docs: update rollout runbook and dashboard instructions
fix(autorollback): avoid triggering rollback on low-sample transient errors

Sofia Ramirez: The debounce window looks reasonable but please add a unit test for the edge case where multiple metrics flip at slightly different windows.
Aisha Kaur: Added integration test that replays interleaved metric flashes and verifies debounce holds. See test(e2e) commit.
Ben Thornton: Please gate the new autorollback behavior behind a feature flag for 2 weeks and ensure the console exposes the toggle (we need staged rollout).
Aisha Kaur: Added feature-flag and console toggle; default off for private as discussed. Will coordinate rollout in release notes.
Marcus Lee: CI found a flaky e2e on first run (timing). Re-ran CI and observed green. Approving after second run.
Ben Thornton: Approving; leave the feature flag documented in runbook.

release_notes: Improvements to unified rollouts: structured rollback events for faster triage, quorum and debounce logic to reduce noisy autorollbacks, new rollout observability panels and playbook updates. Feature-flagged rollout policy changes (opt-in for hosted).
